connections.description: External connections, one values layer per projects/<project>/connections/<name>.yaml.

okdp-lib-chart.description: Values slot Helm creates for the okdp-lib-chart library dependency. Not a parameter.

cpu.title: CPU (vCPU)
cpu.description: CPU limit in vCPU. The request is 250m.

memoryGi.title: Memory (GiB)
memoryGi.description: Memory limit in GiB. The request is 512Mi.

storage.title: Event log store
storage.description: Connection to the S3-compatible object store holding the Spark event logs.

s3SecretRef.title: S3 credentials secret
s3SecretRef.description: Secret with keys accessKey/secretKey, this consumer's own S3 identity.

roleMapping.title: Role mapping
roleMapping.description: OIDC group to Spark ACL mapping (keys admin_groups, history_admin_groups, modify_groups, view_groups).

upstream.title: Upstream chart values
upstream.description: Values of the upstream charts this chart renders, one object per chart, merged over the values it computes: any upstream parameter can be set, except the ones the platform relies on. Maps merge, lists and scalars replace. No key or value may contain '{{'.

spark-history-server.title: spark-history-server
spark-history-server.description: Values of the spark-history-server chart 1.0.0 (oci://quay.io/okdp/charts/spark-history-server), for example image, replicaCount, resources, nodeSelector, tolerations, logLevel, Spark properties under config (single-line scalars). Refused: fullnameOverride, service.name, service.port, ingress, and the Spark properties the platform sets: spark.ui.filters, spark.io.okdp.spark.authc.*, spark.acls.enable, spark.history.ui.acls.*, spark.admin.acls*, spark.history.ui.admin.acls*, spark.modify.acls*, spark.ui.view.acls*, spark.user.groups.mapping, spark.history.fs.logDirectory, spark.history.ui.port, spark.hadoop.fs.s3a.endpoint/path.style.access/access.key/secret.key/session.token/aws.credentials.provider, spark.hadoop.fs.s3a.bucket.*. Appended to the lists this chart sets: extraEnvs, extraVolumes, extraVolumeMounts.

spark-web-proxy.title: spark-web-proxy
spark-web-proxy.description: Values of the spark-web-proxy chart 0.1.0 (oci://quay.io/okdp/charts/spark-web-proxy): image, replicaCount, resources, nodeSelector, tolerations, configuration.logging, configuration.security, ingress.annotations, ... Refused: fullnameOverride, configuration.spark.history, configuration.spark.ui.proxyBase, configuration.spark.jobNamespaces, rbac.create, serviceAccount.create, ingress.enabled/className/hosts/tls.

noTemplate.description: No key or string value, at any depth, contains '{{': upstream charts pass some values to tpl.
